episodes.title: Uriah Wesman Presents Three Cults Walk Into A Bar | Full Comedy Special 2026
episodes.description:
THREE CULTS WALK INTO A BAR is a darkly cinematic comedy special based on the true story of comedian Uriah Wesman, who grew up in three successive cults–including one doomsday cult, was kidnapped by his own mother, and survived a near-death experience. All of that was before Wesman went viral on YouTube, and later reclaimed his own identity through stand-up. Forbes Magazine described the performance as a “psychological thrill.”
